cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

mechanism: A treats objections to removing a roof as incomplete financial lessons and sells the disastrous plan as the only responsible continuation.
confusable: Not simple optimism: A turns every practical problem into a financial necessity for the bad plan.
comparison: Physical restaurant cost cutting versus debt-funded charity commitments.
seedUse: Keep D17 ventilation/roof/rain savings loop; S05 claimed business education grades B objections as beginner calculations.
